_comment: Canonical ordered step list for one walk through the house. Mirrors Bridge/ViewModels/AppFlowStep.swift + SessionViewModel.advance(). The apology ritual (explanation -> ritual -> oath) happens early, before the house map/names, and repeats every session (not just onboarding) -- see the two conditional entries below.

conditional.calmDown: only shown if needsCalmDown (highest intensity >= 7); otherwise room:hall is next after intensityState
conditional.returningCoupleSkipFromWelcomeTo: ritual (skips the onboarding pages, disclaimer, and apology explanation -- the ritual + oath still happen fresh every session)
conditional.returningCoupleSkipFromOathTo: dice (skips house map + names, which a returning couple already has on file)
